rows.Primary Column: Bathroom 3
Delta 4" Tile-In Square Shower Drain - Chrome
rows.PM Notes: ADDED 2026-08-21. Shower drain was missing from this bath entirely. Direction: primaries get linear drains, all other baths get a square drain in matching metal finish. Bath 3 finish is plain chrome, so brand is open. Price comparison for a 4 in. square tile-in point drain in chrome: Delta DT062412 $107 list; Hansgrohe RainDrain Brilliance 4x4 set $828 list; GROHE has no US 4 in. square point drain. Delta selected on price. COST IS AN ESTIMATE at Delta x 0.55 ($58.85 from $107 list). The Delta multiplier is not on the Wieland quote S2478380 - it was back-calculated from the 3754 Claremont Studio 41 proposal S2343240 (04 Nov 2025, Edwin Colon), which has 9 Delta lines. Observed multipliers ran 0.4935 to 0.5704, median 0.5306, mean 0.5305; 0.55 chosen because current list prices are ~9 months newer than that proposal, which depresses the calculated figure, and because Studio 41's verified Brizo multiplier is 0.5496 and Delta Faucet Company owns Brizo. EDWIN MUST STILL QUOTE THIS. Note: T3559LF-WL appears twice on that proposal at two different net prices ($198.48 and $176.17), so Studio 41 Delta pricing is not perfectly uniform.

rows.Primary Column: Hansgrohe Ecostat S Thermostatic Trim with Volume Control and Diverter - Chrome
rows.PM Notes: ADDED 2026-08-21 - closes Studio 41's 17 Jul query "for the bath 3, no controls were selected". Penthouse Bath 3 had a showerhead, a wallbar handshower set, a wall outlet and a lav faucet but NO valve trim and NO rough-in of any kind - nothing to operate the shower. Selected to match this project's own Bath 2 solution: the identical Ecostat S trim + iBox rough pairing is already used in Penthouse Bath 2 and Triplex Bath 2, so the installer sees one Hansgrohe valve platform across three bathrooms. Volume control + diverter is correct for this room's two outlets (overhead 04925000 + handshower on the 04790000 wallbar). Chrome matches the rest of the room (04790000, 04925000, 27458003, 72530001 are all Chrome). Verified on hansgrohe-usa.com: 15758001, Finish Chrome, list $771.00. COST IS DERIVED, CONFIRM WITH EDWIN: $427.75 = $771.00 list x 0.5548, the exact Hansgrohe multiplier on quote S2478380 (verified across 15758701, 04186703, 04388700, 26866701, 26843701, 28276703). This part is not on that quote - it postdates it - so ask Edwin Colon to add it and replace this figure with his quoted price. Alternative considered and rejected: Edwin's GROHE placeholder (29137000 + 35601000) saved only about $65 building-wide and would have put a GROHE valve in an all-Hansgrohe Chrome shower.
